build: Modwerk's linker: core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Temp Save 0.1.0-experimental (package b7ce860c), materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version TS10

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: revision 2ac0f1f; no card (starts formatted); JIT on; --every 1000M; DTBOOT_END_PNG at the end of each run

conditions: Cold boot; eight NO presses from 7003M, 300M apart, close the calibration notices. Then FUNC held from 11003M for 300M with YES pressed at 11103M (12M): TEMP SAVED. The second run repeats that, then FUNC from 12403M for 300M with NO at 12503M (12M): RELOADED. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.

captures.plan: DTBOOT_END_PNG=temp-saved.png dtboot ts10.syx --instr 11303M --every 1000M --press NO@7003M ... --press NO@9103M (8 presses, 300M apart) --press FUNC@11003M:300M --press YES@11103M:12M

DTBOOT_END_PNG=reloaded.png dtboot ts10.syx --instr 12703M --every 1000M --press NO@7003M ... --press NO@9103M (8 presses, 300M apart) --press FUNC@11003M:300M --press YES@11103M:12M --press FUNC@12403M:300M --press NO@12503M:12M
